# Devrious — Complete AI & LLM Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

> Devrious is an independent software engineering studio founded in 2024 in Colombo, Sri Lanka by Savindu Shiranjaya and Rangana Munasinghe. We design, build, test, and secure custom websites, business operations software, REST APIs, AI assistants, and end-to-end AI systems — plus 10 ready-to-deploy Pre-Built POS, ERP, hospitality, fleet, social media, and e-commerce systems.

---

- **Founders:**
  1. **Savindu Shiranjaya** — Co-Founder & Technical Lead. Co-founded Devrious in 2024 to give growing businesses software that is engineered properly — built on a dependable stack, tested before it ships, and supported after launch.
  2. **Rangana Munasinghe** — Co-Founder & Operations Lead. Co-founded Devrious in 2024 with a focus on turning real operational problems into practical, maintainable systems that teams actually enjoy using.
- **Vision:** To be the first software partner growing businesses trust — known for systems that are engineered properly, last for years, and genuinely move the business forward.
- **Mission:** To design, build, test, and support reliable websites, business software, and AI tools that solve real operational problems.
- **Core Commitments:**
  - Understand the business before writing a line of code
  - Ship tested, documented, and secure software
  - Price transparently and support everything we build

### Core Technology Stack
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend & API:** Python, Django, Django REST Framework (DRF), FastAPI
- **Databases & Queues:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Celery
- **Infrastructure & Security:** Docker, Cloudflare WAF/CDN/SSL, GCP, AWS, OCI, OWASP Top 10 hardening
- **Testing & QA:** PyTest, Selenium end-to-end automation

### 5-Step Engineering Delivery Process
1. **01. Discover:** We learn your business, users, and goals, then agree scope, timeline, and price in writing.
2. **02. Design:** Screens and data models are designed and approved before a line of production code.
3. **03. Build:** Development in short cycles with regular demos, so you see progress every week.
4. **04. Test:** Automated PyTest and Selenium suites plus manual QA on real devices.
5. **05. Launch & Support:** Deployment to GCP, OCI, or AWS behind Cloudflare, followed by staff training and support.

## 2. Core Engineering Services (5 Services)

### Service 01: Custom Web Development
- **URL:** https://devrious.lk/services/custom-web-development
- **Starting Price:** LKR 85,000 (~$288 USD)
- **Tagline:** Corporate websites, portals and web applications that load fast and rank well.
- **Description:** From corporate websites to customer portals and full web applications, we build on React, Next.js and Django DRF so your site is fast, secure and easy to grow. Every launch includes search-engine groundwork with Google Search Console and SEMrush plus Cloudflare protection.
- **Standard Engagement Includes:**
  - Responsive React / Next.js front-end, designed for your brand
  - Django DRF back-end with an admin you can manage yourself
  - SEO setup with Google Search Console and SEMrush
  - Cloudflare caching, SSL and DDoS protection
  - Hosting on GCP, OCI or AWS
- **Deliverables:** Responsive production web application; SEO metadata, sitemap & Search Console readiness; Deployment, SSL & post-launch handover.

### Service 02: Custom Software Development

- **Tagline:** Business software shaped around how your team actually works.
- **Description:** Internal tools, operational platforms and management systems designed after we map your real process — not a generic template. We handle discovery, design, development, testing with PyTest and Selenium, and the training your staff need to adopt it.
- **Standard Engagement Includes:**
  - Requirements workshops and process mapping
  - Role-based dashboards and approval flows
  - Integration with your existing tools and data
  - Automated testing with PyTest and Selenium
  - Staff training and post-launch support
- **Deliverables:** Custom web/desktop-accessible business system; Role-based staff accounts & training; Automated backups & cloud deployment.

### Service 03: API Development
- **URL:** https://devrious.lk/services/api-development
- **Starting Price:** LKR 55,000 (~$186 USD)
- **Tagline:** Secure, documented APIs that connect apps, devices and partners.
- **Description:** We design and build REST APIs that connect your mobile apps, hardware devices, payment gateways (PayHere, Stripe) and partner systems — documented, versioned and tested for load and security.
- **Standard Engagement Includes:**
  - REST API design with Django DRF
  - JWT / OAuth authentication and permissions
  - Interactive API documentation (OpenAPI / Swagger)
  - Payment gateway and third-party integrations
  - Load and security testing before release
- **Deliverables:** Production REST API with interactive docs; Automated PyTest integration test suite; Rate-limiting & security header configuration.

### 3.1 Gym POS & Membership System
- **URL:** https://devrious.lk/pre-builts/gym-pos

- **Deployment Timeline:** 1–2 Weeks
- **Summary:** Membership plans, QR check-ins, supplement sales and trainer schedules in one system.
- **Ideal For:** Gyms and fitness centres; Functional training and CrossFit boxes; Yoga, dance and martial arts studios; Multi-branch fitness chains.
- **Core Modules:**
  - Membership plans & renewals (monthly, quarterly, annual, freeze, transfer)
  - QR / card check-in with live payment status
  - Counter sales (supplements, drinks & merchandise with stock tracking)
  - Trainer & class scheduling with commission calculation

- **Included:** Installation and data migration, staff training, receipt printer & barcode scanner setup, 3 months of free support.

## 4. Cybersecurity Services & Packages

- **URL:** https://devrious.lk/cybersecurity-services
- **OWASP Coverage:** OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities; Authentication, session & password handling; Access control & privilege escalation (IDOR/BOLA); SQL injection, XSS & CSRF; Exposed secrets, keys & dependencies; Server, cloud & Cloudflare misconfiguration.
- **Packages:**
  1. **Secure Code Review — LKR 45,000 (~$153 USD):** Up to 5,000 lines of code, OWASP Top 10 & secure-coding checks, secrets & dependency vulnerability scan, findings report with recommended fixes, one walkthrough call with developers.
  2. **API Security Assessment — LKR 75,000 (~$254 USD):** Up to 25 endpoints, authentication & authorisation (IDOR/BOLA) testing, input validation & rate-limit checks, OWASP API Security Top 10 coverage, risk-rated report and one retest.
  3. **Web Application Pen Test (Most Requested) — LKR 95,000 (~$322 USD):** Up to 15 pages or user flows, login/session/access-control testing, injection/XSS/CSRF testing, business-logic abuse scenarios, risk-rated report and one free retest.
  4. **Full Security Audit — LKR 195,000 (~$661 USD):** Web application and API pen test, secure code review of critical modules, cloud & server configuration review (GCP, OCI, AWS), Cloudflare/WAF hardening recommendations, executive summary and two retest rounds.

1. **Avenor Apparel (https://devrious.lk/portfolio/avenor-apparel):** Corporate website (https://avenorapparel.lk/) for Avenor Apparel (Pvt) Ltd, uniting Zevora Custom, Gemora Clothing, and Masha.Ts under one corporate identity. Built on React JS, Django DRF, MySQL, Cloudflare, Search Console, SEMrush.
2. **Zevora Custom (https://devrious.lk/portfolio/zevora-custom):** Animation-rich brand website and custom apparel quote workflow (https://zevoracustom.lk/) for Avenor Apparel (Pvt) Ltd.
3. **Clothing Production Management System (https://devrious.lk/portfolio/clothing-production-system):** Internal garment factory floor tracking system covering intake, cutting, printing, sewing, QC, and dispatch for Avenor Apparel (Pvt) Ltd.
4. **Accommodation Management System (https://devrious.lk/portfolio/sunrise-accommodation):** Property management, availability calendar, invoicing, and housekeeping platform for Sunrise Apartments.
5. **Bus Ticketing Machine Software (https://devrious.lk/portfolio/smart-metro-ticketing):** Offline-first handheld bus ticketing software with thermal printer integration and central Django DRF shift reconciliation for Smart Metro Tech.
6. **Smart Park n Fly (https://devrious.lk/portfolio/smart-park-n-fly):** Transaction-safe UK airport parking slot reservation platform for Smart Park n Fly (UK).
7. **FlexCore (https://devrious.lk/portfolio/flexcore):** Devrious's in-house modular e-commerce storefront platform (https://flexcore.devrious.lk/).

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

- **How does pricing work for custom projects?** Every service has a transparent starting price in LKR (from LKR 55,000 for APIs and LKR 75,000–85,000 for custom software and websites). After a free discovery call, we provide a fixed written quote and milestone schedule before work begins.
- **What technology stack do you build on?** We standardise on React / Next.js + TypeScript for frontends and Python / Django REST Framework with PostgreSQL or MySQL for backends, tested with PyTest and Selenium and deployed on GCP, OCI, or AWS behind Cloudflare.
- **Do we own the source code and cloud accounts?** Yes. Custom-built projects are deployed to infrastructure you control, with full handover documentation, admin access, and staff training.
- **Can a Pre-Built system be customised to our workflow?** Yes. Every Pre-Built is built on our modular React + Django DRF stack, so we can brand it to your company, adjust approval rules, add custom reports, or integrate local payment gateways, SMS, and hardware.
- **How fast can we go live with a Pre-Built?** Most POS systems (Grocery, Pharmacy, Gym, Tuition) and FlexCore go live in 1–2 weeks including item/member data import, hardware setup, and staff training. Larger ERP or multi-lane deployments take 2–4 weeks.
